🎥🚀: Futurama

Futurama follows Philip J. Fry, a pizza delivery man who is accidentally frozen for 1,000 years and awakens in the 31st century. Joined by Leela, Bender, and the Planet Express crew, Fry embarks on outrageous adventures across the galaxy, encountering bizarre aliens, futuristic technology, and hilarious mishaps along the way.

Created by Matt Groening, the series features the voices of Billy West, Katey Sagal, John DiMaggio, Tress MacNeille, Maurice LaMarche, and Phil LaMarr. Beloved for its witty satire, heartfelt storytelling, and imaginative sci-fi setting,  Futurama remains one of the most iconic animated comedies ever made.

Packed with clever humor, unforgettable characters, and imaginative adventures, Futurama explores themes of friendship, technology, and humanity while delivering a perfect blend of science fiction and comedy.

Stream a new season of Futurama August 3rd on Hulu and on Disney+!

source_details.synopsis: Futurama is an American animated science fiction sitcom created by Matt Groening and developed by Groening and David X. Cohen for the Fox Broadcasting Company, and later revived by Comedy Central and then Hulu. The series follows Philip J. Fry, a young man who is cryogenically preserved for 1,000 years and revived on December 31, 2999. Fry finds work at the interplanetary delivery company Planet Express, working alongside the one-eyed mutant Leela and the robot Bender. The series was envisioned by Groening in the mid-1990s while working on The Simpsons; he brought Cohen, a Simpsons writer, aboard to develop storylines and characters to pitch the show to Fox.
